$comment: Forbidden-claim lint for marketing surfaces (sites/jxsuite.com/pages/** + README.md), enforced by scripts/docs/check-site-claims.ts. A pattern hit FAILS unless an `allow` entry (matching id + file, whose `text` is a substring of the matched line/value) covers it. Reword the copy and the allow entry goes stale → CI fails until re-justified. Each allow entry needs one of `evidence` (a repo path or specs/<file>#<anchor>) or `reason` (why the match is not a product claim).

patterns.hint: Reactivity is @vue/reactivity (spec §18). Do not claim TC39 Signals / signals-based reactivity.
No committed Lighthouse measurement exists; do not claim a Lighthouse score.
Build-time figures need a committed benchmark. Measured: ~8s warm for 131 routes.
Uniqueness claims are unverifiable (Webstudio, Silex, Puck, WeWeb exist).
Only assets marked signed:true in packages/desktop/release-assets.json may be described as signed/notarized.
Dollar figures need a source (evidence) or must be labelled illustrative (reason).
